summary: The reviewed supplier-confirmation boundary uses server-only immutable evidence, explicit action rights and current same-hotel Auth/subscription checks. The generated Rules change only extends the shared module-licensing removal list; existing default-deny Rules already deny all direct confirmation/reference subcollection reads and writes. This assessment covers this change, not every existing application boundary.
scope: firebase/firestore.rules: generated procurement licensing keys and orders subcollection default denial
functions/src/supplierConfirmations.js: read/record/review authorization and immutable transaction evidence
functions/src/orderReceiving.js: supplier decision guard and new receipt pricing
functions/src/inventoryCostProposals.js: independently verified historic supplier receipt terms

checks.create_update_delete_bypass: Direct client read/create/update/delete was denied for supplier response and reference evidence, including platform actors. Commands create immutable response/review events and update only the protected parent summary.
checks.authority_source: Fresh verified Auth, authoritative hotel membership and explicit server-side action permissions. Payload actor must match Auth; no self-assigned supplier authenticity or platform bypass.
checks.business_workflow: Orders-only readers receive scoped projections. Coordinators record complete responses; separately assigned terms approvers review them. Existing dispatch, receiving, reversal and shortfall-finalization authority remains distinct.
checks.resource_bounds: Maximum 100 complete response lines, bounded text/decimal quantities/prices, 500 events per order and 25 history events per page. Historical supplier proofs use deduplicated bounded Firestore batches within the existing movement window.
checks.type_safety: Strict supported fields and explicit numeric/date/unknown contracts on server; client validates tenant/order, aggregate/review consistency and exact command acknowledgement before displaying validity.
checks.identity_and_field_security: Hotel-scoped paths at every boundary; no browser writes, cross-hotel customer account matching, global order scan or unauthenticated supplier URL introduced.
checks.history_integrity: Original order and earlier receipt prices remain immutable. New receipt terms refer to a supplier response and an earlier valid hotel review; wrong source, revision, currency or tampered price evidence cannot yield a valid weighted cost.

evidence.local_status: Full security suite passed; updated supplier/receipt/cost boundaries passed focused emulator re-verification. Final acceptance details are recorded in supplier-order-confirmations-plan.md.
evidence.deployed_status: Not run. No merge, production data mutation or deployment was performed.
